title: Open: how manual/additional redeposits added in Salesforce feed back into the allocation tool for the next month

transcript_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: and then we we'll have to figure out how we can get that back into this tool in case you know you're adding a new Ruby deposit and you need to factor those previous decisions for the next month. So we'll have to kind of figure that out.

later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So then I I would even like say like let's not spend time on the upload CSV because this is going to take time. / Joyce Kiddell: Yeah. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, we we can like so like we always need a manual way so that we're going to have to build anyways and this is going to establish the guard rails, the rules, the fields that we we need and everything. / Kobi Kunasekaran: And then we can bolt on the CSV option afterwards.

what_differs: Kobi said the team must work out how manual allocations made in Salesforce get back into Jay's allocation tool so next month's run factors them. No later meeting answers this, and WAGR-464 lists only 're-runs in the middle of the month', not the return path to the tool.
suggested_action: Suggestion: add this as an open decision on WAGR-464 and raise it with WagerTech with the tool inputs/outputs request.
